snippet.title: Burn the Midnight Oil (Visual Novel Demo Trailer)
snippet.description:
Burn the Midnight Oil is now on Kickstarter! You can also find our demo on Steam and itch.io.

A supernatural neon-noir romance visual novel about monsters, love, and other horrors. Playing as the flirtatious vampire detective Circe or the brash hellhound cop Dante, you must solve cases that threaten to unveil dangerous secrets from our protagonists' own pasts. 🖤

Support our Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1291062557/burn-the-midnight-oil-a-supernatural-romance-visual-novel

Play the demo (itchio): https://teamfoxglove.itch.io/burn-the-midnight-oil
Play the demo (steam): https://store.steampowered.com/app/3474200/Burn_the_Midnight_Oil/

Trailer by @lunesonthemoon 
Music by @bellkalengar
